book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, no translation used

sentences.ar: السيد لانتان، موظف بالوزارة، تزوج بنت فقيرة، بس كل الناس قالوا: محظوظ.
sentences.en: Monsieur Lantin, a ministry clerk, married a poor girl, but everyone said: lucky man.

sentences.ar: كانت طيبة، وهادية، وبتضحك، وبتدير البيت بتلاتة آلاف فرنك زي إنها عشرة.
sentences.en: She was kind, quiet, laughing, and ran the house on three thousand francs as if it were ten.

sentences.ar: وكان عندها عيبين بس، حسب زوجها.
sentences.en: And she had only two faults, according to her husband.

sentences.ar: بتحب المسرح، وبتحب المجوهرات المزيفة.
sentences.en: She loved the theatre, and she loved false jewels.

sentences.ar: كانت تروح للمسرح كل أسبوع، وهو ما بيحب، فبتروح مع صديقات.
sentences.en: She went to the theatre every week, and he did not like it, so she went with friends.

sentences.ar: وترجع بعقد زجاج، أو حلق نحاس، وتلبسه، وتقول: شوف كيف بيلمع!
sentences.en: And came back with a glass necklace, or copper earrings, and wore them, and said: see how it shines!

sentences.ar: وهو يضحك، ويقول: بتلبسي زجاج زي إنه ألماس.
sentences.en: And he laughed, and said: you wear glass as if it were diamonds.

sentences.ar: وهي تقول: بحبه.
sentences.en: And she said: I love it.

sentences.ar: وبليلة شتا، رجعت من المسرح مبلولة، وأخدت برد، وماتت بأسبوع.
sentences.en: And one winter night, she came back from the theatre soaked, caught a chill, and died within a week.

sentences.ar: ولانتان كاد يموت وراها.
sentences.en: And Lantin nearly died after her.

sentences.ar: كان يبكي بالمكتب، ويبكي بالشارع، ويبكي بالبيت الفاضي.
sentences.en: He wept at the office, wept in the street, wept in the empty house.

sentences.ar: وبعدين لاحظ شي غريب: ما عاد يقدر يعيش براتبه.
sentences.en: And then he noticed something strange: he could no longer live on his salary.

sentences.ar: نفس الراتب، ونفس البيت، بس المصاري بتخلص قبل نص الشهر.
sentences.en: The same salary, the same house, but the money ran out before mid-month.

sentences.ar: كيف كانت هي بتعمل؟
sentences.en: How had she managed?

sentences.ar: واستلف، وباع أغراض، وبيوم ما بقي معه قرش.
sentences.en: And he borrowed, sold things, and one day had not a penny left.

sentences.ar: وفكر: بيع مجوهراتها المزيفة.
sentences.en: And thought: sell her false jewels.

sentences.ar: يمكن تجيب فرنكين.
sentences.en: Perhaps they fetch a couple of francs.

sentences.ar: أخد العقد الكبير، اللي كانت بتحبه أكتر شي، وراح لمحل صايغ.
sentences.en: He took the big necklace, the one she had loved most, and went to a jeweller's.

sentences.ar: واستحى يدخل.
sentences.en: And was ashamed to go in.

sentences.ar: يبيع زجاج؟
sentences.en: To sell glass?

sentences.ar: وبعدين دخل، وحط العقد عالطاولة، وقال: كم بيسوى؟
sentences.en: And then went in, put the necklace on the counter, and said: how much is it worth?

sentences.ar: الصايغ فحصه طويل، وقال: اتناعشر ألف فرنك.
sentences.en: The jeweller examined it a long time, and said: twelve thousand francs.

sentences.ar: لانتان فتح تمه، وقال: شو؟
sentences.en: Lantin opened his mouth, and said: what?

sentences.ar: هاد مزيف!
sentences.en: This is false!

sentences.ar: قال الصايغ: يا سيدي، أنا بعرف شغلي.
sentences.en: The jeweller said: sir, I know my trade.

sentences.ar: وأخد لانتان العقد، وطلع، وهو بيفكر: الصايغ غلطان.
sentences.en: And Lantin took the necklace, and went out, thinking: the jeweller is wrong.

sentences.ar: أكيد.
sentences.en: Surely.

sentences.ar: وراح لصايغ تاني، أشهر.
sentences.en: And went to another jeweller, a more famous one.

sentences.ar: وهاد قال: هاد العقد بيعته أنا.
sentences.en: And this one said: I sold this necklace myself.

sentences.ar: بعشرين ألف فرنك.
sentences.en: For twenty thousand francs.

sentences.ar: من سنتين.
sentences.en: Two years ago.

sentences.ar: لسيدة.
sentences.en: To a lady.

sentences.ar: وفتح دفتره، وفرجاه الاسم والعنوان.
sentences.en: And opened his book, and showed him the name and address.

sentences.ar: اسم مرته، وعنوان بيته.
sentences.en: His wife's name, and his own address.

sentences.ar: طلع لانتان للشارع، وما عرف وين يروح.
sentences.en: Lantin went out into the street, and did not know where to go.

sentences.ar: عشرين ألف.
sentences.en: Twenty thousand.

sentences.ar: من وين؟
sentences.en: From where?

sentences.ar: وقعد على مقعد بالحديقة، وفكر، وفهم، وما بده يفهم.
sentences.en: And sat on a bench in the park, and thought, and understood, and did not want to understand.

sentences.ar: وبكى مرة تانية.
sentences.en: And wept again.

sentences.ar: بس بكا تاني.
sentences.en: But a different weeping.

sentences.ar: وبعدين قام، ورجع للصايغ، وباع العقد.
sentences.en: And then got up, went back to the jeweller, and sold the necklace.

sentences.ar: وتاني يوم، جاب الباقي: الأساور، والحلق، والخواتم، والمشط.
sentences.en: And the next day, brought the rest: the bracelets, the earrings, the rings, the comb.

sentences.ar: ميتين ألف فرنك.
sentences.en: Two hundred thousand francs.

sentences.ar: وترك الوظيفة، وأكل بأحسن مطعم، وقال للنادل بصوت عالي: أنا ورثت.
sentences.en: And left his job, ate at the best restaurant, and said to the waiter loudly: I have come into money.

sentences.ar: وبعد ستة أشهر، تزوج مرة تانية.
sentences.en: And six months later, he married again.

sentences.ar: مرا شريفة كتير، بس صعبة كتير.
sentences.en: A very virtuous woman, but a very difficult one.

sentences.ar: وعذبته كتير.
sentences.en: And she made him suffer a great deal.
